mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory_gallery_unlocks (user_id, gallery_key, source_memory_id, related_mood, related_excerpt, unlocked_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{galleryKey}, #{sourceMemoryId}, #{relatedMood}, #{relatedExcerpt}, #{unlockedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_memory_gallery_unlocks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND gallery_key = #{galleryKey}

SELECT u.gallery_key AS galleryKey, u.unlocked_at AS unlockedAt, u.related_mood AS relatedMood, u.related_excerpt AS relatedExcerpt, m.id AS sourceMemoryId, m.title AS sourceMemoryTitle, DATE_FORMAT(m.memory_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS sourceMemoryDate, m.image_url AS sourceImageUrl FROM user_memory_gallery_unlocks u LEFT JOIN conversation_memories m ON m.id = u.source_memory_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY u.unlocked_at DESC, u.id DESC

SELECT u.gallery_key AS galleryKey, u.unlocked_at AS unlockedAt, u.related_mood AS relatedMood, u.related_excerpt AS relatedExcerpt, m.id AS sourceMemoryId, m.title AS sourceMemoryTitle, DATE_FORMAT(m.memory_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS sourceMemoryDate, m.image_url AS sourceImageUrl FROM user_memory_gallery_unlocks u LEFT JOIN conversation_memories m ON m.id = u.source_memory_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.gallery_key = #{galleryKey} LIMIT 1
